articles.title: White House adviser defends President Trump's crypto ties in wake of Clarity Act defeat
articles.snippet: President Donald Trump's crypto adviser, Patrick Witt, accused Democrats of unfairly amplifying Trump's crypto ties as a political weapon.

articles.title: Inside the FBI’s little-known annual crypto crime gathering
articles.snippet: The Virtual Asset Technical Exchange brings together investigators, law enforcement officials, and crypto-security specialists to exchange intelligence on a wide range of crimes involving digital assets.

articles.title: Bitcoin's $16 billion quarterly options settlement arrives with a 'call-heavy' book
articles.snippet: Nearly $18 billion in bitcoin and ether options will expire on Friday, potentially reshaping dealer hedging flows and short-term volatility.

articles.title: XRP Ledger retries upgrade that lets banks split payment and compliance duties
articles.snippet: The upgrade could activate Oct. 5, letting businesses give another account limited powers such as making payments or approving customers without handing over full control.

articles.title: Solana starts testing upgrade that could cut finality from 12.8 seconds to 150 milliseconds
articles.snippet: Alpenglow would let exchanges, bridges and merchants treat payments as irreversible almost immediately.
